instruction: Start with freecad_task-5_input.step in FreeCAD. Launch FreeCAD from `/usr/bin/freecad` and open `freecad_task-5_input.step` there. Use the Part Design workbench for the modeling operations; activate or create the relevant Body, create new sketches for sketch-based features, and use feature or placement tools for the requested edits. Add 5 mm fillets or equivalent rounded edges to the four vertical outside edges of the rectangular base. Add 3 mm fillets or equivalent rounded edges to the upper outside edges of both square top bosses. Do not move the base or bosses and do not add holes. Export the final solid as /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-5_output.step.
